command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; voice_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'; }; dtmf_block(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_DTMF/,/Volume Group:/p'; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; PRE=$(voice_block); printf '%s
' "$PRE"; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$PRE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; echo silent_voice_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; VOICE=$(voice_block); DTMF=$(dtmf_block); printf '%s
' "$VOICE"; printf '%s
' "$DTMF"; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Devices: earpiece(1)'; printf '%s
' "$DTMF" | grep -q 'aliased to: STREAM_VOICE_CALL'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; set +e; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.BidirectionalMediaProbe live-smoke 3000" 2>&1); RC=$?; set -e; echo probe_exit=$RC; echo probe_output_begin; printf '%s
' "$OUT"; echo probe_output_end; test "$RC" = "0"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=bidirectional-media-v4'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'mode=live-smoke'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'downlink_context_package=android'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_context_package=com.android.shell'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_dtmf_digit=1'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'uplink_bytes_written=9600'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'pre_dtmf_bytes_read=48000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'post_dtmf_bytes_read=48000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_with_endpoints_open=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_with_endpoints_open=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'media_ok_before_endpoint_close=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'prepared_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'active_after_abort=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_abort=false'; PRENZ=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^pre_dtmf_non_zero_samples=//p' | tail -n1); POSTNZ=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^post_dtmf_non_zero_samples=//p' | tail -n1); echo pre_nonzero=$PRENZ post_nonzero=$POSTNZ; test -n "$PRENZ"; test -n "$POSTNZ"; test $((PRENZ + POSTNZ)) -gt 0; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; trap - EXIT; echo phase2_bidirectional_live_silent_v4_ok=true
